title: Log in and reach the package board with status columns visible
description: Verifies an unauthenticated user can log in and is redirected to the board where packages are displayed in three status columns.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the package board
Verify packages are displayed grouped into three status columns

title: View packages grouped by status on the board
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open the board and see packages grouped by RECEIVED, IN_TRANSIT, and DELIVERED.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify packages are displayed grouped into three status columns

title: Move package from RECEIVED to IN_TRANSIT via drag and drop
description: Verifies a dispatcher can drag a package from RECEIVED to IN_TRANSIT and the card appears in IN_TRANSIT after the move.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Drag a package card from the RECEIVED column and drop it into the IN_TRANSIT column
Verify the dragged package card is displayed in the IN_TRANSIT column

title: Admin can view recipients and drivers lists
description: Verifies an ADMIN user can access the admin area and see both recipients and drivers lists loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation option to open the admin area
Verify the recipients list is displayed
Verify the drivers list is displayed

title: Filter board by status and then clear filters to restore full board
description: Verifies a user can filter packages by a selected status and then clear the filter to reload the full board dataset.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Select a status in the board status filter control
Clear the status filter
Verify packages are displayed across all three status columns

title: Search by tracking ID and clear search to restore full board
description: Verifies a user can search for a package by tracking ID and then clear the search to reload the full board dataset.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Fill a tracking ID value from an existing visible package card into the tracking ID search field
Submit the tracking ID search
Clear the tracking ID search
Verify packages are displayed across the board again (not limited to the prior search result)

title: Create a package from the board and see it appear on the board
description: Verifies an authenticated ops user can create a new package by selecting a recipient and submitting the form, and the new package appears on the board with success feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the package creation form
Fill a unique tracking ID into the tracking ID field
Fill a valid weight into the weight field
Fill valid dimensions into the dimensions fields
Select a recipient from the recipient list
Submit the package creation form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the newly created package appears on the board
